fields.title: Conclusion
fields.md:
1. One-sentence conclusion: The James case oral argument was held as scheduled on 2026-11-03 and no ruling has been issued yet, so E-2028-1 (cumulative loss $2.85 billion, threshold $5 billion or less) and the 25/50/25 probabilities are unchanged — the real gain from this round is fixing a date-design error in the ruling trigger (source: [10-Q R31](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R31.htm) · Section 1).
2. Five-line briefing
   - Oregon Supreme Court held oral argument in the James case on 2026-11-03; a written ruling is expected 'within months' ([OPB](https://www.opb.org/article/2026/11/04/wildfire-survivors-lawsuit-utility-company-fire-oregon/) 2026-11-05).
   - At stake: cumulative Phase 2 verdicts of about $1.25 billion (201 people), about 2,000 additional claims (reported), and the remaining damages trials on hold ([10-Q R31](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R31.htm)).
   - The issues are whether the Phase 1 jury instructions were confusing and whether class-action eligibility applies to the four fires — reports of the mood in the courtroom are not used in the assessment ([KLCC](https://www.klcc.org/crime-law-justice/2026-11-05/oregon-supreme-court-pacificorp-wildfire-lawsuit-arguments)).
   - Correction to the previous round: the 10-Q stated the argument as 'held,' not 'scheduled' · Class B shares closed at $575.25 on 11/9 (previous value $574.76, [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)).
   - The T6 expected date was replaced with the ruling checkpoint of 2027-05-03 (estimated) — so that intermediate event dates passing by do not wake the engine again (Section 1).
3. Three data points to check directly before the next round
   - 3Q26 13F (2026-11-16; formula: quarter-end + 45 days = 11-14 Saturday → next business day) — security-by-security details of 3Q buys and sells (T1).
   - Final prospectus for the yen bond — total issuance vs. the refinancing target of ¥96.4 billion (formula 734 + 230, [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452592/d86634d424b5.htm)) (T8).
   - Oregon Supreme Court ruling notice — if the verdict is reinstated, E-2028-1 and R5 will be re-measured in that round (T6).
